name: search
title: Search the vault
description: Hybrid search over the vault: semantic similarity fused with exact keyword matching, so both paraphrase and literal tokens (hostnames, error codes, IDs) are found. Every hit carries the source path, heading trail and line range it came from — cite those.

query.description: What to look for. Plain language or exact terms.

space.description: Optional Space slug to search within. Omit to search everything.

name: browse
title: List documents
description: List indexed documents. Use when you need the shape of the vault rather than a text query.

pathPrefix.description: Only documents whose path starts with this.

name: read
title: Read a document
description: Read one document's text by vault-relative path. Bounded: the reply reports whether it was truncated.

path.description: Vault-relative path, as returned by search or browse.

name: recent
title: Recently changed documents
description: Documents modified most recently, newest first.

name: memory_context
title: Start with context
description: Call once at the start of a session. Returns the user's SOUL.md (how they want you to work; read-only — never try to edit it) and their most recent decisions and preferences, optionally for one Space. Use `search` for anything more specific.

space.description: Optional Space slug to narrow the decisions and preferences to.

name: memory_save
title: Save a memory
description: Save one durable statement worth remembering in later sessions: a preference, a decision, or a fact about the user or their work. One statement per call, in plain words, e.g. "Prefers Python for scripts." Search first; if a memory already says this, update it instead. An exact repeat returns the existing memory. Never save secrets, credentials, or anything the user asked you not to keep.

space.description: Optional Space slug to file it under; omit or `inbox` for unfiled.

kind.description: preference (how the user likes things), decision (something settled), fact (about the user or their work), or note.

name: memory_forget
title: Forget a memory
description: Delete a memory that is no longer true or that the user asked you to forget. Confirm with the user first. This removes it from search; it does not edit any vault document it came from.

name: health_query
title: Health trends
description: Daily totals and averages of the user's synced Apple Health data (steps, heart rate, HRV, sleep, active energy, …). Pass `metric` for one HealthKit type, or omit it for all. Fails when the user has not allowed Health access.

name: calendar_query
title: Upcoming events
description: Upcoming events from the user's Apple and Google calendars, soonest first. Fails when the user has not allowed Calendar access.

name: reminders_list
title: Open reminders
description: The user's open Apple Reminders, overdue and upcoming, soonest due first (at most 100). Fails when the user has not allowed Reminders access.

name: calendar_create
title: Create an event
description: Propose an event in the user's Apple Calendar, on their iPhone. The user confirms it on a card before anything is added. Needs the app reachable and the user's permission to make changes.

start.description: Start, ISO 8601. With no offset it is read in the user's time zone.

end.description: End, ISO 8601. With no offset it is read in the user's time zone. Defaults to one hour after start.

name: app_reminder_create
title: Create a LuminaVault reminder
description: Create a reminder in LuminaVault that notifies the user at a given time.

fireAt.description: When to fire, ISO 8601. With no offset it is read in the user's time zone.

name: app_reminders_list
title: List LuminaVault reminders
description: The user's upcoming LuminaVault reminders, soonest first.

name: open_screen
title: Open a screen in the app
description: Take the user to a screen in the app. The app performs the navigation.

memoryID.description: Optional memory UUID to open on that screen.
